title: refactor: migrate object detail page to PageSchema-driven rendering
body:
Object Manager detail page was hardcoded React components with a `hasCustomPage` + `<Navigate>` redirect hack in `MetadataDetailPage`. This migrates it to the Spec UI PageSchema protocol so all detail pages are metadata-driven and rendered via `SchemaRenderer`.

### Architecture

Six self-contained widget components registered in `ComponentRegistry`, each resolving data from React context (`useMetadata`, `useMetadataService`) — no prop drilling:

- `object-properties`, `object-relationships`, `object-keys`, `object-data-experience`, `object-data-preview`, `object-field-designer`

A `PageSchema` factory composes them:

```typescript
buildObjectDetailPageSchema('account', item)
// → { type: 'page', pageType: 'record_detail', body: [
//     { type: 'object-properties', objectName: 'account' },
//     { type: 'object-field-designer', objectName: 'account' },
//     ...
//   ]}
```

### MetadataTypeConfig changes

- **Removed**: `hasCustomPage` boolean flag
- **Added**: `pageSchemaFactory: (itemName, item) => PageSchema` — when defined, `MetadataDetailPage` renders via `SchemaRenderer` instead of the default card layout or redirecting
- **Kept**: `customRoute` for hub card linking (decoupled from detail rendering)

### MetadataDetailPage rendering modes (priority order)

1. `pageSchemaFactory` → SchemaRenderer with body nodes
2. `detailComponent` → custom React component
3. Default card layout

### Error handling

`SchemaErrorBoundary` wraps schema rendering in both `MetadataDetailPage` and `ObjectManagerPage` with user-friendly fallback UI on render failures.

### Routes

Both `/system/objects/:objectName` and `/system/metadata/object/:objectName` render the same PageSchema-driven detail view. No redirects.
